titulo: Getaway Files #17: four stars in GTA 6 and his getaway car is a plane #shorts
texto:
Four stars and a plane for a getaway car. The game's own tip says flying lower can reduce your chance of being spotted by law enforcement. So he flies low over the water... a little too low. Pilot error or bad plan?
